summary.t: A set of 12 decorative baubles with personalised messages corresponding to the 12 Christmas wishes.

text.t:
More than just simple ornaments, these are 12 wishes filled with love, hope, and magic to brighten your Christmas.
Each bauble, made of white lacquered MDF and delicately laser-cut, holds a special message to remind us of what truly matters: love, family, friendship, peace, joy, harmony, faith, and the passion of being together.
A set created with care to decorate your Christmas tree and fill every home with tenderness, togetherness, and unforgettable moments.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of young children, who may put it in their mouths.
